15/S0.subgoal: Explain the main categories of AR hardware with examples and application domains.

15/S1.subgoal: Describe AR headsets, their components, and how they differ from VR headsets.

15/S2.subgoal: Describe AR smart glasses and handheld devices, including their examples, sensors, and marker-based or markerless operation.

15/S3.subgoal: Describe spatial AR systems and examples such as interactive projectors, sandboxes, projection keyboards, and projection mapping.

15/S4.subgoal: Explain the remaining AR display categories, head-up displays and AR contact lenses, with examples and open issues.

15/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the AR hardware lecture.
